data.label: include
data.reason_zh: 使验证器成为可检查的进化对象，由失败聚类合成并按参考集选择，用于下游技能循环。

scope_support.feedback_quote: synthesized from clustered failures, gated at birth, and selected for agreement with a ten-item anchored reference set plus consensus over unlabeled outputs
scope_support.object_quote: We make the verifier the evolving object: an inspectable expression over small, mostly deterministic drawback detectors, synthesized from clustered failures
scope_support.persistence_quote: an evolved verifier can substitute: Double Ratchet, pairing the verifier with a lifecycle-managed skill loop, retains 88-110% of the lift
